remarks: Phenomenal opportunity to get into the highly desirable Harris Hill section of Clarence! Set upon a spacious half-acre lot & offering over 2,100+ square feet of living space, this unique home is packed with potential & ready for your finishing touches! Whether you're looking to build sweat equity, customize your dream home, or invest in one of WNY’s most sought-after suburban communities, this property delivers outstanding value, size, & flexibility. Step inside & discover a layout designed for comfortable everyday living with room for everyone to live, work, & play! A standout feature of the home is the TWO Primary Suites, one on each floor, creating ideal possibilities for multigenerational living, guest accommodations, or private work-from-home arrangements. The HUGE Great Room features a handsome fireplace along with multiple oversized windows welcoming an abundance of natural light into the space. Enjoy breathtaking views overlooking your neighbor to the north - approximately 25 acres owned by the WNY Land Conservancy, providing a peaceful & scenic backdrop rarely found at this price point. The working kitchen offers a functional layout and flows directly into the adjacent formal dining room, creating excellent entertainment potential. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout much of the home & provide a timeless foundation ready to shine with your personal updates & design vision. Attached two-car garage is currently finished with drywall & carpeting, offering valuable bonus space for recreation, hobbies, fitness, a playroom, or an additional entertainment area. Full basement adds even more storage & expansion possibilities. Additional highlights include a brand new electrical service, mostly new interior plumbing. East facing front door, & spacious room sizes. This property is priced to reflect needed updates & improvements, making it an incredible opportunity for buyers looking to personalize a home while building long-term equity in an exceptional location. Seller is open to helping buyers reach their homeownership goals! Square footage confirmed by listing agent.
